# video-shotcraft

> video-shotcraft is an AI agent skill for Claude Code and Codex that crafts cinematic product promo videos with Remotion. It ships 124 shot recipe cards covering 150 styles with 150 motion previews, reusable Remotion components, SFX assets, a six-stage production methodology, and a production-ready 36.2-second promo template (Ink Press).

Each shot recipe card documents a motion technique: purpose, energy level, suggested duration, tuned parameters, implementation notes, and known pitfalls, paired with a tuned Remotion (TSX) reference implementation.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft#readme): what the skill does, quick start, showcase videos
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft/blob/main/SKILL.md): agent entry point and core production rules
- [Production pipeline](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft/blob/main/references/pipeline.md): six-stage workflow
- [Ink Press template](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/video-shotcraft/blob/main/template/TEMPLATE.md): complete 36.2s promo template
- [Gallery landing](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/): what the skill is, categories overview
- [Shot library](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html): browse all shot cards and motion previews

## Shot recipe cards

### Opening & Brand

- [brand-ink-open](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#brand-ink-open): Ink crosshairs draw in, the wordmark stamps letter by letter, a subtitle types on, then the lockup holds and lifts away.
- [crane-rise-reveal](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#crane-rise-reveal): The camera starts tight on one data row, rises and pulls back, then reveals a full dashboard filling the frame.
- [dataviz-landscape-open](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#dataviz-landscape-open): Streams of light merge across a dark data landscape while labels hover and a shallow-depth camera glides forward.
- [fracture](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#fracture): Twenty-five 3D tiles fly in from scattered space and lock into a poster in a center-out ripple, hold for a beat, then accelerate outward off-screen in all directions.
- [icon-field-colorize](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#icon-field-colorize): A grid of grayscale icons staggers in to fill the screen, holds a beat, then brand-color bands ripple down and light the whole field at once.
- [letterspace-materialize](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#letterspace-materialize): Every letter of a widely tracked wordmark draws itself in parallel, growing like handwriting and finishing together on the same frame.
- [magician-card-flourish](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#magician-card-flourish): A blue starburst flashes on black for a third of a second, then a card shoots out of the flash, spinning along an arc toward camera before freezing near full frame.
- [orbit-ring-title-open](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#orbit-ring-title-open): Eight 16:9 content cards orbit an ellipse at a constant rate with their contents frozen on the first frame, then all start playing together while the centred headline de-blurs into place and a marker block sweeps across the key phrase.
- [spotlight-hero-card](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#spotlight-hero-card): A spotlight selects one card, the camera pushes diagonally, the card lifts for two outline passes, then returns to the page.
- [stroke-segment-build](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#stroke-segment-build): Disconnected title strokes illuminate in a scrambled order and become readable only when the final segments snap into place.
- [text-as-mask](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#text-as-mask): Product footage moves inside oversized title letters before the type expands until the footage takes over the frame.

### Typography & Title Cards

- [blur-slide](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#blur-slide): Title words rise into place one after another as vertical offset, blur, and opacity converge on a single shared ease, with the subtitle following before the title settles.
- [brace-expand](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#brace-expand): A tight pair of braces appears at center, then springs apart and scales up to title size, revealing the text through a clip width bound strictly to the brace gap.
- [countdown-arc-scatter](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#countdown-arc-scatter): Numbers arranged tangentially along a large arc sweep past and brake to a stop, the winning digit sliding out of the dial to become the first character of the headline.
- [document-typewriter-reveal](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#document-typewriter-reveal): A fully typeset document writes itself behind one accent-color caret, opens both side columns, and drops history entries into the rail.
- [flying-words](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#flying-words): Keywords spawn deep in a perspective tunnel and rush past the camera along the z axis, fading in and out on a lifecycle curve across two seamless loops.
- [glitch-cycle](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#glitch-cycle): Status phrases cycle through one monospace slot, each dissolving into noise at both ends with RGB split and jitter, while a progress bar tracks the whole run.
- [gradient-word-sweep](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#gradient-word-sweep): A gradient light sweeps left to right across a keyword, charging each character with glow that decays behind the wavefront until the whole word breathes.
- [lead-word-zoom-assemble](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#lead-word-zoom-assemble): The lead word fills the frame at 2.3x and keeps drifting toward the viewer, then a single curve recedes it to size while the line slides left and the trailing words are pushed into their slots — pivoting on the lead word centre and the measured baseline.
- [marker-underline-title](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#marker-underline-title): After the headline settles, a marker stroke draws itself under the keyword — tapered, rough-edged, and slightly tilted to follow the italic.
- [outline-word-fill](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#outline-word-fill): An outlined word snaps down from triple size while a dashed circle and horizontal guides close in, then the stroke flips to solid white in a single frame with one brief glow.
- [paper-title-card](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#paper-title-card): A sentence stamps onto paper word by word, highlights one amber italic term, and closes with a short rule.
- [pill-chip-slot-cycle-handled](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#pill-chip-slot-cycle-handled): A dark chip inside the sentence rolls through feature words, its width easing to each word so the surrounding text is pushed apart while grey ghost items show above and below.
- [pill-slot-cycle](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#pill-slot-cycle): A fixed sentence keeps its trailing pill slot spinning like a slot machine through feature words until the final word locks the sentence.
- [text-column-converge](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#text-column-converge): Two words pinned at opposite screen edges hard-swap through options, then slide together exactly once to lock into the final phrase.
- [title-demote-to-label](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#title-demote-to-label): A centered headline stands for a beat, then shrinks and slides to the top-left corner to become a section label as content grows beneath it.
- [type-assembly-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#type-assembly-moves): Three typography assemblies: split-letter rise, drifting convergence, and text flowing along a path.
- [type-entrance-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#type-entrance-moves): Letters falling under gravity and bouncing into alignment as a title entrance.
- [type-rhythm-sync](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#type-rhythm-sync): Two voice-and-beat synchronizations: font weight pulsing on percussion and spoken words filling like karaoke.
- [typewriter-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#typewriter-moves): A three-act typing narrative: a plain word, a hesitation and deletion, then a faster retype of the selling point.
- [vertical-word-roll-blur-cycle](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#vertical-word-roll-blur-cycle): The closing word of a tagline rolls vertically through a three-line reel, neighbouring rows blurring into grey depth while the settled word takes the accent color.
- [word-relay-filmstrip](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#word-relay-filmstrip): A filmstrip of page cards steps vertically while a serif word relay swaps only its verb, each swap aligned to the center of the current card.
- [word-relay-geometry](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#word-relay-geometry): Three benefit words hand off in turn, each with its own geometry — a spinning dashed circle, three interlocking circles that trim into view, and a metallic sheen that resolves to pure white.

### UI Entrance & Showcase

- [avatar-bracket-carousel](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#avatar-bracket-carousel): A four-corner focus bracket stays locked mid-sentence while a vertical queue of avatars springs through it three times, each one sharpening and growing as it enters the frame and shrinking, dimming and blurring as it leaves.
- [bezier-source-converge-merge](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#bezier-source-converge-merge): Four source nodes each draw a thin bezier curve toward one convergence point, then slide along their own curve and shrink as if swallowed, while accent data packets glide the paths and the curves erase backward.
- [card-stack](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#card-stack): Eight cards spring up from below the frame one after another and pile into a single stack, then the whole pile fans out into a 3D arc as each card rotates, slides sideways and steps back in depth.
- [carousel-3d](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#carousel-3d): Eight cards sit on a circular ring laid out with sin and cos, spinning through exactly one full revolution while each card billboards outward with matched front and back faces so it never reads as mirrored or upside down.
- [cloner-depth-echo](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#cloner-depth-echo): A card duplicates into a diagonal depth trail, holds briefly, then accelerates back into one springy original.
- [deck-deal-flyin](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#deck-deal-flyin): A physical card stack opens the scene, then cards accelerate into a live grid as the camera follows the growing page.
- [doc-park-left-pill-deal](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#doc-park-left-pill-deal): The source document slides left until only a sliver remains and keeps scrolling slowly, while three outlined pills are dealt one at a time, each followed by a caption that darkens word by word.
- [draw-svg-trace](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#draw-svg-trace): An ink stroke traces an element outline, closes with a dark flash, and hands focus to the revealed content.
- [element-body-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#element-body-moves): A contact shadow that separates during lift, giving interface elements physical weight.
- [integration-hub-map](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#integration-hub-map): A page flips 180 degrees into an integration hub where five app icons pop in together and rainbow light tubes connect with pulses flowing through them.
- [list-reveal](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#list-reveal): Menu rows scale into place one after another with a faint overshoot while the whole list drifts slowly upward, keeping the per-item entrance and the group motion on two independent layers.
- [list-stack-press](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#list-stack-press): List cards fly up from below, compress the growing stack on every landing, and advance a synchronized counter.
- [neon-frame-forerun](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#neon-frame-forerun): A neon frame races ahead to outline the scene in steep perspective while components drop from above and the page brightens as they land.
- [neon-frame-orbit-drop](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#neon-frame-orbit-drop): After a neon frame draws itself, the camera arcs left to right while every page component drops from the air and lands on the same frame.
- [page-waterfall-wall](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#page-waterfall-wall): Real page captures flow at different speeds across a tilted 3D wall, creating an endless field of content.
- [product-card-progressive-assemble](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#product-card-progressive-assemble): A product card builds itself field by field as image, title and pills pop in, the old price gets struck through while an accent new price springs out, and highlighter blocks sweep across the copy.
- [radial-wave](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#radial-wave): A 17x9 dot grid lights up in rings that spread outward from the center, each dot overshooting its scale before settling into a steady glow, then a brighter pulse collapses back inward from the edges.
- [research-card-stack-scroll](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#research-card-stack-scroll): Dark paper cards drop into the center every twelve frames and pile along a downward-right axis, squashing on landing while only the topmost card renders its full text as the rest blur into the stack.
- [row-embed](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#row-embed): Content rows descend with perspective, flatten into the page, and flash a thin amber seam at the moment of insertion.
- [value-stagger-gradient](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#value-stagger-gradient): Sixteen bars rise in a staggered sweep where height, hue, travel distance and blur are each spread as a gradient across the row, then a second beat re-origins the stagger at the center so the pulse amplitude fans out symmetrically.
- [wall-reveal-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#wall-reveal-moves): Two in-place wall reveals: sequential bento lights and a wireframe drawing itself into a finished interface.

### Camera & Space

- [basic-3d-scene](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#basic-3d-scene): Impress-style spatial slides: cards sit at scattered 3D poses and the camera flies to align with each one by inverting its transform, ending on a pulled-back overview where every card lights up.
- [crash-zoom-punch](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#crash-zoom-punch): A six-frame push races from a wide view to a target close-up, ending with either an elastic overshoot or a heavy impact stop.
- [cursor-flyover](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#cursor-flyover): After an overview fade-in the camera flies to each of four screen corners in turn while an SVG cursor arrives with it, pointing and leaving a click ripple at every stop.
- [depth-layer-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#depth-layer-moves): Layered parallax rails: three speed tiers slide past to build depth, and the hero floats up as the rail settles.
- [graze-face-tour](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#graze-face-tour): The camera skims low across the UI surface like terrain while page text hovers above the interface and settles down as the shot advances.
- [overhead-camera-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#overhead-camera-moves): Two overhead reveals: a tilted scene leveling into view, and a tabletop layout dropping sharply into place.
- [space-camera-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#space-camera-moves): Three spatial camera moves: exploded assembly, subject-locked rotation, and a drone-like dive to the landing point.
- [steep-tilt-glide](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#steep-tilt-glide): A page stands at a steep 60-degree perspective and glides across a fixed camera with speed ghosting while text settles onto the surface mid-flight.
- [tension-camera-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#tension-camera-moves): Two emotional camera tools: a frozen orbit and an isolating pull-back.
- [terminal-3d](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#terminal-3d): Three terminal windows float at different poses in 3D space; the camera flies between them with a sine pull-back, and at each stop a command types out and its results slide in line by line.

### Data & Metrics

- [before-after-slider-scrub](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#before-after-slider-scrub): Before and after views share one frame while a fast-then-slow slider reveals the processed result.
- [chart-live-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#chart-live-moves): Three data-driven motions: a live oscilloscope trace, dots regrouping into a figure, and an axis forced to rescale.
- [gauge-readout-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#gauge-readout-moves): Two instrument reads: a full-range needle self-test and a moving scale that races beneath a fixed pointer.
- [scroll-brake-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#scroll-brake-moves): Two fast-scroll stops: a long page decelerating precisely onto a target, and the same stop paired with a locking reticle.
- [timeline-travel](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#timeline-travel): The camera accelerates along a horizontal version timeline, raises cards at each stop, then brakes sharply on the final milestone.

### Interaction & Feature Demo

- [autolayout-gap-dial](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#autolayout-gap-dial): A gap value dial pushes a row of blocks apart in real time while badge digits tick, then everything springs back into place.
- [canvas-materialize-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#canvas-materialize-moves): Two materialize moves: table rows arc out of a panel and morph into canvas cards, and a typed prompt grows a cascading diagram tree.
- [chip-grid-single-select-blackout](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#chip-grid-single-select-blackout): Five option chips fade in, then a single grey press frame flashes before the chosen chip turns solid black with a tiny bounce while the others drop to eighteen percent without moving.
- [collab-cursor-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#collab-cursor-moves): A five-cursor ensemble drifting and typing across a shared board as living collaboration ambience.
- [glass-pill-dictation-typing](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#glass-pill-dictation-typing): A fixed-width glass pill pops in slightly oversized and settles, glowing with an accent gradient inside that fades out as a placeholder sentence types across it.
- [hashtag-to-pill-materialize](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#hashtag-to-pill-materialize): A typed "#word" hard-cuts into a wide pill tag, holds, shrinks into its slot on the page, then hard-cuts again to reveal the finished view.
- [picker-carousel-feature-cycle](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#picker-carousel-feature-cycle): A vertical mobile-style picker holds its focus pill still while the list passes through it, each item decelerating hard into place and resting for several frames before the next.
- [segmented-thumb-hero](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#segmented-thumb-hero): An oversized segmented control gets a close-up: a cursor slides in, presses, and the white thumb snaps to the other segment as icons swap with a spring.
- [theme-switch-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#theme-switch-moves): Two theme-change patterns: a diagonal sweep that recolors content in place, and a command-palette ripple with a clear cause and effect.
- [type-and-filter](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#type-and-filter): A real interface types a search, collapses the grid to one result, then clicks through into the detail view.
- [voice-waveform-live](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#voice-waveform-live): A recording capsule shows 64 live bars that surge with speech, shrink to a dotted line in pauses, and collapse on submit.

### Transitions

- [bottom-push-stack-wipe](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#bottom-push-stack-wipe): Each new scene pushes up from the bottom edge with its own saturated background color, physically shoving the old scene out of frame.
- [card-flip-reveal](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#card-flip-reveal): Feature cards rotate 180 degrees around the Y axis, flash at the edge, and reveal a large result on the back.
- [card-flock-tumble](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#card-flock-tumble): Three UI cards tumble in 3D from edge-on to a stepped formation, keep slowly rotating, then collapse inward and burst into a smoke ring under a giant word.
- [circle-match-iris](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#circle-match-iris): An iris expands from a circular UI element and lands on a matching circle in the next scene.
- [gradient-transition](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#gradient-transition): The background morphs smoothly through linear, radial, and conic CSS gradients — angle, color stops, center, and radius each interpolated per-parameter with narrow cross-fades between types.
- [line-carry-transition](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#line-carry-transition): A progress line exits scene A, guides the camera sideways, then turns corners to become the frame of scene B.
- [mosaic-reframe](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#mosaic-reframe): Twelve tiles morph continuously between a regular grid, a feature mosaic with one hero slot, and a rotated diagonal cascade, each tile interpolating position and size independently with a slight stagger.
- [page-turn-transitions](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#page-turn-transitions): A full-page transition where the old page splits open like double doors to reveal the new one.
- [print-texture-transitions](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#print-texture-transitions): A print-based reveal: ink bleeding outward from a drop point to consume the old scene.
- [shot-transitions](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#shot-transitions): Three handoff recipes for matching scene energy: flash cut, braking whip pan, and portal mask wipe.
- [tear-streak-transitions](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#tear-streak-transitions): A high-energy tear: horizontal glitch strips whose displacement hides the hard cut.
- [transition-hidden-cut](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#transition-hidden-cut): Three ways to conceal the edit: foreground occlusion, opposing impacts, and a brief amber light leak at the cut.
- [transition-travel](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#transition-travel): A passage transition that pushes through the counter of a giant letterform into the next scene.
- [white-flash-logo-simplify-cut](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#white-flash-logo-simplify-cut): A liquid six-color gradient wordmark shimmers in place, the frame flash-burns to white with a blur-and-brightness pulse, and a flat gradient wordmark fades in and settles on the white.
- [wipe-transitions](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#wipe-transitions): A geometric wipe: twelve staggered vertical blinds flipping in a wave.

### Rhythm & Montage

- [beat-cut-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#beat-cut-moves): A three-flash freeze montage: white flashes hard-cut through different crops of the same subject and settle on the key number.
- [beat-step-list-theme-cycle](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#beat-step-list-theme-cycle): An adjective list steps up one row per beat while a fixed center pill catches each word and the background recolors on the same beat.
- [panel-grid-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#panel-grid-moves): An angled comic-panel split that cuts one moment into three framings before resolving to a poster.
- [quad-split-parallel-scenes](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#quad-split-parallel-scenes): The frame hard-cuts into a 2×2 grid where four micro-scenes run in parallel — typing, a whip zoom, word pops, and a cursor interaction chain — with every beat offset by a few frames.
- [rhythm-interrupt-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#rhythm-interrupt-moves): Stepped punch-in jump cuts that break cadence on the same frame.
- [sakuga-timing-shift](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#sakuga-timing-shift): Movement begins in stepped, held drawings and suddenly switches to frame-by-frame acceleration at the climax.
- [speed-ramp-freeze](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#speed-ramp-freeze): A freeze used for on-screen annotation before motion resumes.
- [trailer-grammar-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#trailer-grammar-moves): A trailer bumper hook: three 9-frame rapid cuts, a beat of black silence, then the opening title card.

### Light & Emphasis

- [assemble-then-type-flyin](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#assemble-then-type-flyin): Textless component shells fly in from every direction onto an empty dark grid, then every character arrives from 3D space with its own large rotation and settles into position.
- [aurora-bloom-bg-flip](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#aurora-bloom-bg-flip): A soft purple-orange aurora blob rises from the bottom of a light frame, then the whole background slams dark in under half a second while the copy blur-swaps to a new line.
- [brand-frame-snap](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#brand-frame-snap): A thick brand-color frame grows around the screen before content arrives, then hard-flips its color on the same frame the inner layout switches.
- [fui-hud-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#fui-hud-moves): A reticle that assembles itself around a target and locks on.
- [glow-flyline-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#glow-flyline-moves): Three dark-scene accents: ambient glow orbs, connecting flight arcs, and a synchronized orb-to-line relay.
- [icon-performance-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#icon-performance-moves): An escalating attention bounce that compresses on landing to call the eye to an icon.
- [impact-feedback](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#impact-feedback): Two impact layers: a combo counter with damage feedback, and a full anime-style impact frame.
- [light-play-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#light-play-moves): Two controlled light effects: a spotlight sweep that reveals the title and a single sheen pass across a card.
- [radial-ripple-phone-chips](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#radial-ripple-phone-chips): Four concentric grey circles breathe out of phase like water ripples while a centered phone mockup auto-scrolls its feed and two white feature chips spring in and hover.
- [riso-print-hits](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#riso-print-hits): A risograph impact: a single misregistered colour split that snaps into alignment.
- [scan-bracket-sweep](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#scan-bracket-sweep): A skeleton document pops to center, black L-shaped framing brackets drop into its corners, and a thin line with a gradient trail sweeps up and down across it five times.
- [scanline-annotate-focus](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#scanline-annotate-focus): A bright scanline travels down the page and, as it clears each block, camera framing brackets snap inward onto that region and a monospace caption types out beside it.
- [scanline-assemble-flyin](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#scanline-assemble-flyin): The page starts as an empty dark grid; a scanline descends and each component flies in from off-screen to snap into place behind it, with motion blur and a bright edge flash on landing.
- [slam-entrance-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#slam-entrance-moves): Three high-energy arrivals: a perspective snap, a score drop, and an impact burst that pushes nearby elements.
- [spotlight-sweep-moves](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#spotlight-sweep-moves): Three dark-scene spotlight moves: a wake-sleep sweep, an edge-glow pan with purple bleed, and a radial reveal expanding from a corner.

### Outro

- [grain-dissolve](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#grain-dissolve): A clean line of text boils into displaced grain noise inside a hatched selection frame, then the particle cloud condenses into a larger glowing wordmark that locks sharp.
- [logo-shrink-wordmark-lockup](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#logo-shrink-wordmark-lockup): A neon slit ring shrinks fast into a solid white O with an overshoot brake, slides left to make room, letters stagger in one by one, and an accent slogan fades in below.
- [neon-triple-marquee](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#neon-triple-marquee): Three rows of outlined neon giants scroll in opposite directions across the full screen, lighting up in turn on a one-third phase offset.
- [outro-group-photo-launch](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#outro-group-photo-launch): Elements from the film assemble around the wordmark as a crane settle, stage light, and gold dust create a launch-event finale.
- [ui-strip-away-outro](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#ui-strip-away-outro): After Publish is clicked the editor UI evaporates layer by layer from the edges inward, leaving one button to slide center, grow, and hand off to the wordmark.
- [ui-to-brand-morph](https://vincentwei1021.github.io/video-shotcraft/library.html#ui-to-brand-morph): Two UI-to-brand morphs: an icon flips flat and blooms into a logo mark, and an input field contracts into a capsule as glyphs assemble the logo.
